name: Cerveja Coral
verdict: Beer brand of the Madeira Brewery (Empresa de Cervejas da Madeira), part of the Pestana Group, whose holding is wholly owned by Dionísio Fernandes Pestana. Nothing found.
note: Madeira beer brand of the Madeira Brewery (Empresa de Cervejas da Madeira), controlled since 1999 by the Pestana Group with the Miles family. On the back of Marítimo's 2026-27 home shirt (also back at Nacional in 2026-27). Rating note (2026-10-03): ownership now sourced from ECM's own site ('part of the Pestana Group') and Pestana International Holdings' consolidated annual report 2022 (100% owned by Dionísio Fernandes Pestana). News search found pay and strike disputes at ECM (dnoticias.pt 6 Apr 2022; abrilabril.pt) and a 2020 Brazilian labour judgment against a Pestana hotel in Rio over withheld service-charge percentages (migalhas.com.br): individual wage/labour disputes, not human-rights findings of the kind METHOD.md counts. No UN/NGO/court human-rights finding against ECM or the Pestana Group found.
